result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with residential and commercial land uses. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features wide travel lanes that likely encourage higher vehicle speeds, creating a hostile environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without any refuge or marked crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway spanning from left to right sidewalks

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in both directions

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to shorten crossing distances and slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and associated signage to designate a safe crossing point.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide but poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to a mixed-use building. There is a notable lack of marked crossings or pedestrian safety infrastructure at the visible intersection corner.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left and center sidewalk area

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The corner lacks marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large tree and grassy mound at the corner may obstruct the view between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the corner.

result.summary: The street is a wide, four-lane commercial arterial with a sidewalk present on only one side and no marked pedestrian crossings. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design, featuring utility pole obstructions in the walkway and a lack of physical buffers between pedestrians and high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane configuration encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly within the narrow sidewalk path on the right side of the street, reducing effective width.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas visible, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a center turn lane or median refuge and wider, buffered sidewalks.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to facilitate safer crossings.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The presence of large surface parking lots and a lack of street trees or buffers creates a hostile environment for walking, with long unprotected crossing distances.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The main road is very wide with multiple lanes and no marked crosswalk or refuge, forcing pedestrians to cross a long distance exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: No traffic signals or pedestrian signals are visible to manage the interaction between vehicles and people at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the main road and side street.

hazards.name: Large Driveway Openings
hazards.description: The wide asphalt lot creates a large area where vehicles can cross the pedestrian path without clear definition.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, in front of the commercial building.

interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
